Magical.name: Heal
Magical.description: Restores the target's HP with 50 Power.

Magical.name: Cure Poison
Magical.description: Cures the target of minor poisoning.

Magical.name: Battle Heal
Magical.description: Immediately restores the target's HP with 83 Power.

Magical.name: Group Heal
Magical.description: Restores all party members' HP with 66 Power.

Magical.name: Aura Burn
Magical.description: Inflicts non-Attribute damage on an enemy with 19 Power added to M. Atk.

Magical.name: Wind Strike
Magical.description: Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 12 Power to create a powerful hurricane that inflicts Wind damage on an enemy.

Magical.name: Sand Strike
Magical.description:
Inflicts earth damage on an enemy with 39 Power added to M. Atk.
Over-hit is possible.

Magical.name: Nature Absorb
Magical.description: Inflicts earth damage with 18 Power added to M. Atk. Activates Natural Replenishment.

Magical.name: Rune of Rebirth
Magical.description: Gathers energy from fallen enemies to restore their own health. Recovers 63 HP per second.

Magical.name: Sand Gust
Magical.description: Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 13 Power to conjure a whirling sandstorm that inflicts Earth damage on an enemies.

Magical.name: Rock Throw
Magical.description: Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 23 Power to create a powerful Rock Hunk that inflicts Earth damage on an enemy.

Magical.name: Rune Bolt
Magical.description: Inflicts non-Attribute runic damage on an enemy using 13 Power added to M. Atk.

Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects.
P. Atk. +6%
P. Def. +6%.

Buff.name: Mass Improved Combat
Buff.description:
Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects.
For party members:
P. Atk. +6%
P. Def. +6%.

Debuff.name: Curse Weakness
Debuff.description: Decreases an enemy's P. Atk. by 17%.

Debuff.description: Creates a poison cloud around an enemy, causing loss of 24 HP per second.

Debuff.name: Curse Poison
Debuff.description: Poisons an enemy, causing loss of 11 HP every second.

Debuff.name: Surrender to Earth
Debuff.description:
Resistance to Earth -15%.
When applied, cancels 'Resist Earth' from the target.

Debuff.name: Earth Grasp
Debuff.description: Decreases an enemy's Speed by 20% and HP Regeneration by 15%.

Toggle.name: Block Buff
Toggle.description:
Switchable skill.
Your character cannot receive external buff effects.

Special.name: PvE Clarity

Equipment.name: Create Item
Equipment.description:
Allows the user to manufacture level 1 items.
Dwarven Manufacture size: +1 slot.

Equipment.name: Robe Mastery
Equipment.description:
With Robe Armor:
P. Def. +2
M. Def. +1%.

Equipment.name: Weapon Mastery
Equipment.description: Increases P. Atk. by 1.5 and M. Atk. by 1.9.

Ability.name: Lucky
Ability.description: At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.

Ability.name: Higher Mana Gain
